Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit THIS existing 4x4 VFX animation sprite sheet. Keep all SIXTEEN individual painted drawings and their order, colors, material, newly changing shapes, and relative sizes. The only correction is layout isolation: original cells have neighboring-frame fragments crossing into them. Reflow into an EXACT uniform4columns4rows grid. Use normalized cell centers at 12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of canvas width and height.
Give every cell generous completely TRANSPARENT gutters. Shrink ALL existing glyphs by the SAME factor about0.65 before arranging them, preserving the progressive size changes of the impact and all texture differences. Maximum painted glyph width or height only15%of whole sheet (60%of its25%cell). Every nonzero-alpha pixel of an effect must be fully inside its assigned cell, at least20%of cell width away from each edge. No fragments from another frame may occur in a cell. No entire colored glow field and no blurry opaque cell background. Truly clean transparent alpha. Do not simplify artwork, no new decorative additions, no card or text or label or visible grid.
TOP TWO ROWS: keep the8distinct orb loop poses, centered in their individual cells. BOTTOM TWO ROWS: keep8different rightward animated trails; keep luminous lead tip at75%cellwidth and50%cellheight, fading tail toleft. Keep only trails, remove all alien fragments from orbs above.
Square sprite sheet, transparent background, bright hand-painted light fantasy, no photorealistic rendering. Output is production art, not a concept sheet.
